response.rationale: R3 (PCNSL) best explains the homogeneous enhancing corpus callosum mass with rim enhancement and no central restricted diffusion, along with high CSF protein and low glucose. R1 (GBM) is less consistent because GBM typically shows heterogeneous necrosis and central restricted diffusion. Other candidates lack specific imaging or CSF support.

rejected.why: PML typically non-enhancing, no mass effect, and occurs in immunocompromised; here HIV negative and enhancement present.
Toxoplasmosis usually ring-enhancing with central necrosis and positive serology; here negative cultures and no raw support.
ADEM is multifocal and often post-infectious; here single mass with rim enhancement and acellular CSF.
Neuroinflammation is nonspecific and lacks imaging or CSF specificity.
